summary.en: Trade GPU time, take odd jobs and repay your debt in 40 days.
summary.zh: 倒腾算力、做零工、交房租，40 天还清培训贷。

caption.en: Plan your workday and compare buy and sell prices
caption.zh: 安排今天的零工和休息，查看交易所买卖价

caption.en: Choose where to go before ending the day
caption.zh: 收工前在地图上选明天的去处

notes.en: Workplace satire, mild language, debt and simulated trading with fictional money.
notes.zh: 职场讽刺、轻度粗口，以及虚构债务和游戏币交易。
